title: Mona Lisa
shortDescription: Half-length portrait painting by Leonardo da Vinci.
longDescription: Considered an archetypal masterpiece of the Italian Renaissance, it has been described as 'the best known, the most visited, the most written about, the most sung about, the most parodied work of art in the world.'

title: The Starry Night
shortDescription: Famous painting by Vincent van Gogh.
longDescription: Painted in June 1889, it depicts the view from the east-facing window of his asylum room at Saint-Rémy-de-Provence.
place: Museum of Modern Art, New York

title: The Thinker
longDescription: The sculpture depicts a man in sober meditation battling a powerful internal struggle.
